question: Pramod, Akhil, and Raman can do a piece of work in 14 days. Akhil and Raman can do the same work in 77 days. Find the number of days in which Pramod can complete the same work.
solution:
**Given**

Pramod, Akhil, and Raman can do a piece of work in 14 days.

Akhil and Raman can do the same work in 77 days.

**Concept:**

Work done is directly proportional to the number of days and the number of workers.

**Solution:**

⇒ The combined rate of Pramod, Akhil, and Raman = 1/14 work/day

⇒ The combined rate of Akhil and Raman = 1/77 work/day

⇒ The rate of Pramod = 1/14 - 1/77 = 9/154 work/day

⇒ Therefore, the time Pramod would take = 154/9 days

**Hence, Pramod can complete the same work in 154/9 days.**
